positive.response: Preserve the successful visible workflow and its original evidence. Independent verification confirms all five saved project/WAV/MIDI sets, exact 30.000-second WAVs, sample-exact full saved-graph reproduction and actual audio/VST mix contributions through separate source ablations. This does not establish heard musical quality, sustained live playback reliability, physical-device behavior or broad plug-in compatibility.

duplicate_tool.response: The toolbar Duplicate selects a persistent tool and exposes Click a clip to duplicate; context/Edit Duplicate performs an immediate copy. Preserve consistent tool/action semantics and the visible instruction. Initial discovery and repeated-copy steps remain recorded friction. Repeat to loop end is an existing alternative for filling a chosen range; no new duplication behavior or reduced click count is claimed.

precise_trim.response: A zoomed-out drag can require a small correction from 30.134 to 30.000 seconds. Preserve the observation and existing snap, source and Undo semantics. Properties duration entry and an exact loop duration followed by Repeat to loop end remain mouse-accessible alternatives. All five final WAVs verify as exactly 30.000 seconds, but that does not prove every one-drag endpoint is exact or that trimming friction is newly fixed.

send_routing_steps.response: Participants 1 and 2 explicitly found the per-channel Add send → Routing → + Send sequence redundant, repeating earlier feedback. The final change opens the destination chooser directly from an empty strip using the same helper as the toolbar. The chooser names its source and retains explicit eligible destination selection; an existing Send summary still opens Routing for detailed edits. Source ownership, cancellation without selection/project/history changes, graph eligibility and one-step Undo/Redo are covered by the affected tests. Independent native Dark/Light review confirmed readable menus and cancellation from an unselected bus while another channel remained selected. No participant rating or musical outcome is retroactively attributed to this post-study polish.
send_routing_steps.ratings_scope: All round 9 ratings precede this final polish. No fourth full beginner study is planned, so validation must not be represented as a new participant score.

audio_failure.response: All five reports retain their output-stream failures. The separate CPAL-only probe reproduced Xrun followed by the same snd_pcm_avail_delay EIO under injected 60 ms callback stalls, without RILL code. Default and named output share one PCM, and a larger requested buffer was not demonstrated to remedy the failure. Each participant stall’s actual cause remains unknown. Keep fatal handling, explicit Retry/Audio setup and raw diagnostics; no audio product fix or physical-hardware reliability conclusion is claimed.

audio_recovery.response: Retry and later UI activity sometimes restored Pause, transport movement or meters; repeated later failures and unknown recovery causes remain in the record. Such visual activity does not establish heard audio or uninterrupted playback. Preserve explicit recovery controls and diagnostics without treating a selected device name or unrelated edit as a proven remedy. The actual restart sequence requires separate stream-state evidence before changing classification or restart behavior.

audio_preparation.response: Participant 4 saw Preparing audio before transport progress. Keep visible preparation feedback for stretched audio and the asynchronous preparation path. The wait is acknowledged; these observations do not isolate its cost or establish a performance defect. No faster preparation, lower latency or new progress estimate is claimed.

native_dialog.response: Native-picker paint delay, transient black rectangles and visual separation remain documented. The laboratory has no window manager, so these captures do not isolate an app defect or establish normal desktop behavior. Retain native dialogs and require ordinary-desktop reproduction before changing their integration. Verified file completion does not erase the presentation friction.

export_wait.response: WAV export showed elapsed progress and later completion. Preserve asynchronous export and clear receipts. The visible wait is a session impression; screenshot/tool overhead and the virtual environment prevent treating these timings as hardware or throughput benchmarks. No faster export or time-to-completion estimate is claimed.

untested_scope.response: Only the supplied audio and Rill Lab Sine VST3 were exercised in a small composition/mixer/export task. Other plug-ins, effects, advanced production features, physical hardware and audible quality remain untested by these sessions. Do not infer their absence or general compatibility from task completion.

sparse_mixer_space.response: Participants 1 and 3 found the few-channel mixer sparse. Preserve readable channel widths and room for more channels rather than filling unused space with unrelated panels or stretching controls to inconsistent sizes. Record this appearance preference; no new layout feature is claimed.

clip_label_readability.response: Participants 2 and 5 noted truncated names in the fitted full arrangement. Keep text within each clip’s time bounds to avoid overlapping neighbors. Zooming or opening a clip provides more space and its editor title. The readability preference remains recorded; no typography or naming fix is claimed.

stretch_bound.response: Participant 4 stretched an original four-beat source to 16 beats and then saw Range: 1–16 again. That is the supported source-rate bound: 25%–400% of the original source speed allows 1–16 beats for that source window. Reopening Stretch must not compound 16 to 64 and bypass the original rate limit. Preserve the exact observation, visible range and successful duplication alternative. Treat this as discovery friction around a correct bound, with no new stretch feature or range-regression fix claimed.
stretch_bound.contract: Source window remains the original four beats; current occurrence length 16 at 25% rate is already at its maximum supported duration.

note_origin_perception.response: Preserve P5-F4 and its confusion rating verbatim. Read-only review found that screenshot 07, taken before the claimed correction, already shows C4 at the zero-time edge. Recorded press x=65 maps to beat 0, and the saved four notes begin at 0/1/2/3 with 0.75-beat lengths. The later Select drag starts at x=143 on the C4 row, outside the note ending near x=119, consistent with marquee selection rather than moving it. No recurrence of the round 8 onset defect is established by this evidence. Participant 1 independently has correct 0/1/2/3 native onsets. This does not explain unseen intermediate frames or prove universal input reliability, and does not justify rewriting the participant’s perception or score.
